title: Machine Learning Analysis of U.S. Power Grid Outages
description: Analyzed 1,515 major outages and developed performance metrics to quantify outage severity, duration, and regional risk patterns. Trained Logistic Regression and Decision Tree models with scikit-learn Pipelines and GridSearchCV, and ran a 5,000-trial fairness analysis revealing significant disparities across NERC regions (p=0.0016).

title: AI Powered Community College Transfer Planner
description: Built an AI-driven academic pathway generator using dependency graphs to optimize student course sequencing and identify key bottlenecks. Designed ETL pipelines transforming articulation rules into structured data and created APIs that surface completion timelines, requirement fulfillment metrics, and optimal-term recommendations.

title: College Research Automation Platform
description: Developed an analytics platform for GetItWrite College Advising supporting data-driven decision-making for dozens of users. Integrated the College Scorecard API to analyze tuition, acceptance rate, financial aid, and student outcomes, and implemented Google OAuth with automated Sheets workflows.

title: PDF Automation for College Counseling Workflows
description: Engineered a PDF-extraction pipeline (PDFPlumber + Pandas) to automatically pull key metrics from College Kickstart reports. Built a Chrome Extension that processes PDFs and extracts college lists, acceptance categories, and reach/match/safety designations, integrating clean datasets directly into Google Sheets to eliminate hours of manual data entry.
